seam_free_render_control.description: Ablation separating pure geometric camera rotation from seam selection and feathering

B_single_source_bounded.GEOMETRY_ONLY_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Virtually zero geometric bend change (+0.04 px) when single-source projected

D_normal_bounded_seam.SEAM_OWNERSHIP_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: The graph-cut seam boundary shifted across slightly different edge textures, causing +1.07 px change in equirectangular edge detection.

feather_diagnostic.conclusion: Feathering (0px vs 6px) causes less than 0.03 px variation. Feathering is NOT the cause of the measured difference.

alternate_source_recovery_audit.conclusion: Alternate source recovery affects only 0.27% of structural edges and does not materially alter measured structural straightness.
